title: chat-client: deprecate blob methods as thin wrappers over jmap-blob-client
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B15. Crates: jmap-chat-client. Size: S.

Per docs/design/DECISIONS.md decision 12 and docs/design/blobext.md §9 step 2: once jmap-blob-client exists, make the chat-client blob methods and their types #[deprecated(note = "use jmap-blob-client")] thin wrappers that delegate to jmap-blob-client, keeping the signatures fixed in tna1.1 (non-breaking: repo stability policy deprecates before removing). Add the chat-client -> blob-client dependency; update RELEASING.md (jmap-chat-client moves from layer 4 to 5) and AGENTS.md dependency tree; docs point at jmap-blob-client. Acceptance: wiremock tests show each wrapper sends the same request body as before; deprecation attributes visible in the public-api snapshot; CHANGELOG 'Deprecated' entry; workspace builds without new warnings outside allowed deprecated uses in tests.
